news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Earnings have declined by 27% per year over the past 5 years. Market cap is less than US$10m (₹214.3m market cap, or US$2.30m). Minor Risks Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months

news.title: Investor sentiment deteriorates as stock falls 19%
news.body: After last week's 19% share price decline to ₹3.26, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 5.3x. Average trailing P/E is 22x in the Capital Markets industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 29% over the past three years.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.65 (vs ₹0.015 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.65 (up from ₹0.015 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹55.7m (down 63% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹36.4m (up ₹37.2m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 65% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 43% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 4% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.09 loss per share (vs ₹0.24 profit in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: ₹0.09 loss per share (down from ₹0.24 profit in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹337.6m (up 45% from 2Q 2025). Net loss: ₹5.14m (down 138% from profit in 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 90 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.
